text:
tess: Quick flag: jump in fncall schema rejects in eu-west-2 canary. Spike from 0.15% -> 0.9% in 15m. Sample log: {error: 'type_mismatch', path: 'params.user', expected: 'object', got: 'string'}. tagging @derek @sophia
derek: Thanks. Which validator is in the canary?
deploy-bot: Canary status: feature=fncall-validate-v5, region=eu-west-2, rollout_pct=8, status=running
sophia: Telemetry gap: when rejects occur pre-routing we lose route_id and account_id. Need those for dashboards and billing.
tess: Spike concentrated on a few API keys; looks client-related but we should avoid customer-facing errors. Two options: 1) flip validator to SOFT-FAIL so we log and pass; 2) enable mediation heuristics (e.g., string->object wrap) and log a mediation event.
maya: I prefer mediation with an audit flag. Soft-fail hides root causes and can mask bad client behavior. Mediation gives us both continuity and traceability.
derek: Agreed if mediation emits: mediation_applied, mediation_reason enum (WRAP_STRING, NULL_TO_EMPTY, COERCE_NUMBER), orig_error, validator_version, route_id, account_id. Also increment fncall.mediation.count metric.
sophia: I'll add event schema and alerting. Alert: page eng-oncall if mediation_rate > 0.4% or rejects climb > 0.5% after mediation. Also sample full redacted payloads at 2% for mediated events.
tess: Console UX: show users a redacted suggestion panel when mediation applied with a one-click "opt-in" to auto-apply for that key. Default OFF.
derek: Rollout plan: enable MEDIATE_SUGGEST in canary (5%), collect metrics 24h, then consider MEDIATE_AUTO at 1% with strict observability. Keep quota attribution to original route via mediation_override_route flag.
maya: Please add quick rollback steps to the playbook and a console rollout note. Ticket INF-5100 for mediation rollout + dashboard mock.
sophia: Opening PR for telemetry: https://git.internal/repo/telemetry/PR-512. Will include standardized error codes: TYPE_MISMATCH, EXTRA_FIELDS, MISSING_REQUIRED, UNPARSEABLE, and mediation enum mapping.
derek: I'll flip MEDIATE_SUGGEST in the canary and annotate the rollout with mediation=true.
deploy-bot: Update applied: fncall-validate-v5 mode=MEDIATE_SUGGEST, rollout_pct->5 in eu-west-2. Change recorded at 2024-08-01T12:05:00Z
tess: Good. Follow-up: ensure dashboards can filter by validator_version and mediation_reason. Closing thread; track work in INF-5100. :thumbsup:
